Bushfire — Yarra Valley: 0412 hrs. Fast-moving grassfire reported east of Healesville, wind NNW gusting 55 km/h, pushing fire toward the township. Estimated front 3 km wide. Two farm properties confirmed alight. Unknown number of residents still on properties along Chum Creek Rd. Local CFA brigade on scene, requesting support. Smoke reducing visibility on the Maroondah Hwy. Power lines down near the golf course.
Flash flood — Brisbane suburb: 1830 hrs. Creek broke its banks after 140 mm rain in 3 hours. Water through ground floor of a 40-unit apartment block on Riverside Dr, residents sheltering on upper floors. Two vehicles swept off the causeway, occupants unaccounted for. Sewage contamination reported. Bridge on Miller St structurally uncertain. Rain forecast to continue for 4 more hours.
Chemical release — industrial estate: 1105 hrs. Ruptured tank at a fertiliser plant releasing ammonia vapour. Plume drifting SE toward a primary school 800 m away. Plant reports 3 workers exposed, 1 unconscious. Wind 12 km/h, temperature 28C. Fire alarm activated, roughly 60 staff self-evacuated to the car park which is downwind. Nearest hazmat capability is 45 minutes away.
